name: uCompute Junior (Pico / Pico W)
notes: JP Michon's carrier for a socketed Pico or Pico W. Reports itself as the Pico, so pick it by hand in the Board menu (use the Pico 2 entry for a Pico 2 or 2 W). 1.3" 240x240 ST7789 on SPI bus 0 (GP2/GP3), no CS or backlight pin: the backlight is always on. The maker's code drives it in SPI mode 3 (polarity 1, phase 1). Alternative SSD1306 OLED (0x3C) and a CAT24 EEPROM (0x50) share I2C bus 0 on GP20/GP21. The three buttons share GP26 through a resistor ladder: idle reads above 40000, right below 7000, select below 12000, left below 16000 (read_u16). Buzzer on GP11 (PWM), NeoPixel header on GP6. MicroSD and the add-on module socket share SPI bus 1 (GP14/GP15/GP12), SD CS GP13, module CS GP8, INT GP9, RST GP10. H1 header, left to right: 5V, GND, 3V3, GND, GP16, GP17, GP18, GP19, GP22, GP7, GP27, GP28, GP1, GP0. GP0/GP1 also drive the TX/RX LEDs. The Pico's own LED isn't reachable here. Pins are from the maker's README, walkthrough and test code (github.com/JPMichon/uComputeJr); check your own unit.
